1029. Telephone Directory Management

50

Medium

Problem Statement:
Insert, update, delete and append telephone details of an individual or a company into a telephone directory using structures and pointers.
input_spec:
The first line of the input is the integer number indicating the number of items in the telephone directory.

It is followed by the input of N items in the telephone directory in the below format:

< name > < telephone number >

The next line of the input O denotes the operation that needs to be performed in the given telephone directory. Below are the different kinds operations that are available:

1 - Insert and Display

2 - Update and Display

3 - Delete and Display

The last line of the input varies as per the above-chosen operation as below:

Insert and Display:

The value of the new record that needs to be inserted in the below format

< name > < telephone number >

Update and Display:

The value of the current telephone number and the new record that needs to be updated in the below format

< current telephone number > < new name > < new telephone number >

Delete and Display:

The value of the current telephone number that needs to be deleted in the below format

< current telephone number >
output_spec: Print the updated telephone directory after performing the selected operation O.
